title: Integrate Hermes adapter with runtime

context.summary: Make the Hermes adapter lifecycle usable against the real Mindory HTTP runtime.
context.background: TASK-24 hardened the CLI. Hermes now needs an end-to-end adapter surface that ensures identity, builds context, saves turns, uploads attachments and can recall source-backed context in later sessions.

in: Keep Hermes adapter HTTP-only and SDK-agnostic.
Ensure project, peers and session before prompt/context operations.
Build prompt context before the model call through /v1/context/build.
Save user and assistant turns through session message routes.
Upload attachments through /v1/documents and preserve upload refs in message metadata.
Add a lifecycle helper and smoke validation for cross-session context recall behavior.
Prevent identity ensure calls from clearing existing session summaries.
out: Import or depend on a Hermes SDK.
Add direct database, Redis, storage or vector access.

acceptance_criteria: Hermes adapter exposes a lifecycle helper that prepares context and saves turns through the HTTP API.
Identity ensure creates/upserts project, user peer, agent peer and session records.
Prompt context is built before saving the current turn.
User and assistant turns are saved with Hermes source metadata.
Attachments are uploaded and referenced from saved message metadata.
Hermes optional tools ensure identity before memory/document API calls.
Session ensure/upsert does not erase existing session summaries.
Docs and validations describe the runtime integration boundary.

manual_checks: Confirm Hermes adapter has no Hermes SDK import.
Confirm Hermes adapter has no direct DB/Redis/storage/vector imports.
Confirm lifecycle helper builds context before saving messages.

risks: Smoke coverage uses the injectable HTTP client; live Hermes integration remains environment-dependent.
Attachment-to-message linking is represented in message metadata until a dedicated attachment API is added.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch can be merged into master without unrelated changes.
